subject: GEOGRAPHY
name: Physical Features of India
summary: The land in six pieces, each built a different way: young folded Himalayas still rising, flat plains laid down grain by grain by great rivers, an ancient hard plateau older than them all, a sandy desert in the west, coastal strips flanked by hills, and two very different island chains.

hi.name: भारत के भौतिक स्वरूप

mr.name: भारताची प्राकृतिक रचना
mr.summary: भूमी सहा तुकड्यांत, प्रत्येक वेगळ्या रीतीने बनलेला: अजून उठणारे तरुण घडीचे हिमालय, महान नद्यांनी कण-कण अंथरलेली सपाट मैदाने, या सर्वांहून जुने कठीण पठार, पश्चिमेला वालुकामय वाळवंट, टेकड्यांनी लगत असलेल्या किनारी पट्ट्या, आणि दोन अतिशय वेगळ्या बेट-साखळ्या.

questions.stem: Along India's northern edge rise the world's highest ranges, young fold mountains still growing as two great plates press together. Which physical division is this?
questions.solution: The Himalayas are young fold mountains along India's north — the world's highest ranges, running in three roughly parallel ranges and still rising as the plates beneath them collide. That is the fact this question turns on.

hi.stem: भारत के उत्तरी किनारे पर दुनिया की सबसे ऊँची शृंखलाएँ उठतीं, युवा मुड़े पर्वत जो दो महान प्लेटों के दबते अब भी बढ़ते। यह कौन-सा भौतिक विभाग है?

questions.stem: In the far west, along the border, lies a dry expanse of rolling sand dunes with scanty rain and only seasonal streams. Which physical division is this?

यह दो पहाड़ी श्रेणियों, पश्चिमी और पूर्वी घाट, से घिरा, जो तटीय मैदानों तक उतरतीं और काफ़ी हद तक तय करतीं इसकी नदियाँ किधर बहें।

यह एक स्थिर, प्राचीन खंड है जो टिका रहा जबकि युवा पर्वत उसके चारों ओर मुड़े — उसकी चट्टानें भारत का अधिकांश कोयला, लोहा और अन्य खनिज रखतीं।
hi.solution: भारत के द्वीप दो अलग समूह — अरब सागर में मूँगा लक्षद्वीप, और बंगाल की खाड़ी में बड़े, पहाड़ी, आंशिक ज्वालामुखीय अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीप। यह द्वीप समूह की बात है, प्रायद्वीपीय पठारी खंड की नहीं — बाक़ी तीनों यहाँ सही हैं।

questions.stem: All of the following are true of The Indian Desert EXCEPT —
choices: The Indian Desert, the Thar, is an arid land of rolling sand dunes along the western edge, with very low rainfall and streams that flow only in the rainy season.
Rainfall is meagre and uneven, so vegetation is thin and scattered, and the Luni is almost the only river of any size across it.
Its dunes shift with the wind, and life here — from the desert's grasses to its people — is shaped by the constant scarcity of water.
The Coastal Plains are narrow strips of low land between the Ghats and the sea on India's eastern and western flanks, holding ports, lagoons, and river deltas.
questions.solution: The Coastal Plains are narrow strips of low land between the Ghats and the sea on India's eastern and western flanks, holding ports, lagoons, and river deltas. That belongs to The Coastal Plains belt, not The Indian Desert — the other three are all true here.

choices: भारतीय मरुस्थल, थार, पश्चिमी किनारे के साथ लहराते रेत के टीलों की शुष्क भूमि है, बहुत कम वर्षा और केवल बरसात में बहती धाराओं वाली।

questions.stem: The Northern Plains cover only a modest share of India's area, yet they feed a huge part of its people and are the most densely settled land in the country. What combination of natural gifts makes them so productive?
choices: Deep, fertile alluvial soil renewed by the rivers, land that is flat and easy to plough and irrigate, and a steady supply of river water together make farming rich — so people have gathered there in great numbers for millennia
The plains are rich only because they contain the most minerals and coal
They are productive because they are the highest and coldest part of India
The plains grow crops without any soil, using only sand
questions.solution: The plains' productivity is no accident of one feature but the meeting of three, all supplied by the great rivers. First, the soil: for thousands of years the Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra and their tributaries have carried down fine silt from the mountains and spread it across the plains, building deep, fertile alluvial soil constantly refreshed by floods — among the best farmland on Earth. Second, the shape of the land: because that soil was laid down layer by layer as level deposits, the plains are almost perfectly flat, which makes them easy to plough, easy to cross with roads and canals, and easy to irrigate, since water can be led across gently sloping ground. Third, the water itself: the same perennial rivers that built the soil also supply it, so fields have a dependable source for irrigation through the year. Rich soil, flat ground and abundant water are exactly the conditions that let farmers grow large, reliable harvests, and where food is plentiful, dense human settlement follows. That is why this modest slice of India's area has been its agricultural heartland and its most crowded region for millennia, home to great cities and civilisations along the rivers. The minerals and coal that make the peninsular plateau valuable are a different kind of wealth entirely — the plains are prized for soil and water, not stone.

hi.stem: उत्तरी मैदान भारत के क्षेत्रफल का केवल मामूली हिस्सा ढकते, फिर भी वे इसके लोगों का बड़ा भाग पालते और देश की सबसे घनी बसी भूमि हैं। प्राकृतिक उपहारों का कौन-सा संयोजन उन्हें इतना उत्पादक बनाता?
choices: नदियों द्वारा नवीकृत गहरी, उपजाऊ जलोढ़ मिट्टी, समतल और जोतने-सींचने में आसान भूमि, और नदी-जल की स्थिर आपूर्ति मिलकर खेती समृद्ध करते — अतः लोग वहाँ सहस्राब्दियों से बड़ी संख्या में जुटे
मैदान समृद्ध केवल इसलिए कि उनमें सबसे अधिक खनिज और कोयला
वे उत्पादक क्योंकि वे भारत का सबसे ऊँचा और ठंडा भाग
मैदान बिना किसी मिट्टी के, केवल रेत से फ़सल उगाते
hi.solution: मैदानों की उत्पादकता एक विशेषता का संयोग नहीं बल्कि तीन का मिलन, सब महान नदियों द्वारा दिए। पहला, मिट्टी: हज़ारों वर्षों से सिंधु, गंगा और ब्रह्मपुत्र और उनकी सहायक नदियाँ पर्वतों से महीन गाद नीचे लातीं और मैदानों पर फैलातीं, गहरी, उपजाऊ जलोढ़ मिट्टी बनातीं बाढ़ों से निरंतर तरोताज़ा — पृथ्वी की सबसे अच्छी कृषि-भूमि में। दूसरा, भूमि का आकार: क्योंकि वह मिट्टी समतल जमाव के रूप में परत-दर-परत बिछी, मैदान लगभग पूर्णतः समतल, जो उन्हें जोतने में आसान, सड़कों-नहरों से पार करने में आसान, और सींचने में आसान बनाता, क्योंकि पानी हल्की ढलान वाली भूमि पर ले जाया जा सकता। तीसरा, पानी स्वयं: वही बारहमासी नदियाँ जो मिट्टी बनातीं उसे आपूर्ति भी करतीं, अतः खेतों को साल भर सिंचाई का भरोसेमंद स्रोत। समृद्ध मिट्टी, समतल भूमि और भरपूर पानी ठीक वे परिस्थितियाँ जो किसानों को बड़ी, भरोसेमंद फ़सलें उगाने देतीं, और जहाँ भोजन भरपूर, वहाँ घनी मानव-बस्ती चलती। इसी से भारत के क्षेत्रफल का यह मामूली टुकड़ा सहस्राब्दियों इसका कृषि-हृदय और सबसे भीड़-भरा क्षेत्र रहा, नदियों के किनारे महान नगरों-सभ्यताओं का घर। जो खनिज-कोयला प्रायद्वीपीय पठार को मूल्यवान बनाते वह बिलकुल भिन्न प्रकार का धन — मैदान मिट्टी-पानी को सराहे जाते, पत्थर को नहीं।

mr.stem: उत्तर मैदाने भारताच्या क्षेत्रफळाचा फक्त माफक वाटा व्यापतात, तरी ती त्याच्या लोकांचा मोठा भाग पोसतात आणि देशातील सर्वांत दाट वस्तीची भूमी आहेत. नैसर्गिक देणग्यांचे कोणते संयोजन त्यांना इतके उत्पादक बनवते?
choices: नद्यांनी नूतनीकृत खोल, सुपीक गाळाची माती, सपाट आणि नांगरायला-सिंचायला सोपी जमीन, आणि नदी-पाण्याचा स्थिर पुरवठा मिळून शेती समृद्ध करतात — म्हणून लोक तिथे सहस्रकांपासून मोठ्या संख्येने जमले
मैदाने समृद्ध फक्त म्हणून की त्यांत सर्वांत अधिक खनिजे आणि कोळसा
ती उत्पादक कारण ती भारताचा सर्वांत उंच आणि थंड भाग
मैदाने कोणत्याही मातीविना, फक्त वाळूने पीक घेतात
mr.solution: मैदानांची उत्पादकता एका वैशिष्ट्याचा योगायोग नव्हे तर तिघांचे मिलन, सारे महान नद्यांनी दिलेले. पहिले, माती: हजारो वर्षांपासून सिंधू, गंगा आणि ब्रह्मपुत्रा आणि त्यांच्या उपनद्या पर्वतांतून बारीक गाळ खाली आणतात आणि मैदानांवर पसरवतात, खोल, सुपीक गाळाची माती बनवत पुरांनी सतत टवटवीत — पृथ्वीवरील सर्वांत उत्तम शेतजमिनीत. दुसरे, जमिनीचा आकार: कारण ती माती सपाट साचांच्या रूपात थर-दर-थर अंथरली, मैदाने जवळपास पूर्णपणे सपाट, जे त्यांना नांगरायला सोपे, रस्ते-कालव्यांनी ओलांडायला सोपे, आणि सिंचायला सोपे बनवते, कारण पाणी सौम्य उताराच्या जमिनीवर नेता येते. तिसरे, पाणी स्वतः: तीच बारमाही नद्या ज्या माती बनवतात तिला पुरवठाही करतात, म्हणून शेतांना वर्षभर सिंचनाचा भरवशाचा स्रोत. समृद्ध माती, सपाट जमीन आणि भरपूर पाणी नेमक्या त्या परिस्थिती ज्या शेतकऱ्यांना मोठी, भरवशाची पिके घेऊ देतात, आणि जिथे अन्न भरपूर, तिथे दाट मानवी वस्ती चालते. म्हणूनच भारताच्या क्षेत्रफळाचा हा माफक तुकडा सहस्रकांपासून त्याचे कृषी-हृदय आणि सर्वांत गर्दीचा प्रदेश राहिला, नद्यांकाठी महान शहरे-संस्कृतींचे घर. जी खनिजे-कोळसा द्वीपकल्पीय पठाराला मौल्यवान बनवतात ते अगदी वेगळ्या प्रकारचे धन — मैदाने माती-पाण्यासाठी नावाजली जातात, दगडासाठी नाही.

questions.stem: Geologists call the Himalayas 'young' mountains still rising, but the Peninsular Plateau one of the oldest and most stable landmasses on Earth. How can two parts of the same country differ so completely in age and behaviour?
choices: The plateau is an ancient, rigid block of hard rock that has stayed stable for hundreds of millions of years; the Himalayas are young folds thrown up where the drifting Indian plate collided with Asia, and because that collision continues, the mountains are still being pushed higher and shaken by earthquakes
The Himalayas are young only because they were built recently by people
The plateau is actually younger than the Himalayas but looks old
All mountains and plateaus on Earth are exactly the same age
questions.solution: The difference comes from how each landform was made, and whether the force that made it is still at work. The Peninsular Plateau is a piece of very old, hard crust — igneous and metamorphic rock formed hundreds of millions of years ago and long since cooled into a rigid, stable block. It was once part of an ancient supercontinent, and although it has been worn down and cracked over vast time, it has not been folded or thrust up by active mountain-building for ages; that is why it is a relatively level, quiet tableland, and why its rocks are so old and mineral-rich. The Himalayas are the exact opposite in origin. They are 'fold' mountains, created where two of Earth's great tectonic plates crumpled against each other. The Indian plate, carrying the peninsula, drifted north over millions of years and slammed into the Eurasian plate; the sediments and crust caught between them were squeezed and buckled upward into towering folds — a process that, geologically speaking, happened recently and, crucially, is not finished. The Indian plate is still pushing north, so the Himalayas are still being lifted higher and are seismically restless, which is why the region suffers frequent earthquakes. So 'young' and 'old' here are not about years of scenery but about geological history: the plateau is an ancient survivor that stopped changing long ago, while the Himalayas are a work still in progress, rising even as we watch. Same country, two utterly different chapters of the Earth's story.
